description: Register a payment for a document (Holded API v2). Supported docTypes: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, purchase — others throw an unsupported error. IMPORTANT: this may AUTO-APPROVE the document as a side effect (status 0→1). `paymentmethod` is the payment-method catalog id (from list_payment_methods), NOT a bank/treasury id. To link the payment to a bank account, pass `bankId`: the /payments endpoint can't set it, so the tool performs a second step (PUT /payments/{id}) and reports the outcome in `_warnings`.

bankId.description: Bank account id to link the payment to. Triggers a second step (PUT /payments/{id}) to set the bank link on the payment.

paymentmethod.description: Payment-method catalog id (from list_payment_methods), NOT a bank/treasury id.

name: pay_document
